performance.verdict: Meta dark since Sep 9 — zero spend 5 days straight, restart is the only move.

findings.text: channel_dark:meta confirmed — zero spend Sep 9–13 (5 consecutive days); $0 delivered vs $65–75/day SOW target. All leads have stopped.
⛔ Extension with Marwan overdue Aug 31 — engagement is month-to-month lapsed; no signed contract gates next 3 months of activity.
⛔ SMS automation and Zoho Voice access both overdue Aug 31 — contact rate is the stated bottleneck yet CRM intake tools remain undeployed.
GHL pipeline shows 0 opportunities created from 24 contacts vs 30 Windsor leads — intake leak: leads arriving but no opps, not an ads problem.
28-day CPL of $46.95 is above the July range of $19–45/wk high end; 3-day trend (Sep 11–13) shows $0 spend — efficiency is unreadable until Meta restarts.

suggestions.text: Diagnose and restart Meta 'Leads - August Re-Launch' at $65/day immediately — 5 zero-spend days are a full stop.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta has been completely dark since Sep 9, recording $0 spend for 5 consecutive days against a $65–75/day SOW target. Hamza/Hamdan to check account status, payment method, and campaign approval today and restore the 'Leads - August Re-Launch' campaign to $65/day. Success check: confirmed spend showing in Meta Ads Manager by Sep 15, and at least 1 lead recorded in Windsor within 48 hours of restart. If the account is flagged or restricted, escalate to Sohib immediately — do not attempt workarounds without approval.

suggestions.text: Fix GHL intake: 24 contacts, 0 opportunities created — pipeline is not converting leads to opps at all.
suggestions.monday_update: Windsor reports 30 leads over 28 days but GHL shows only 24 contacts and 0 opportunities created — this is a CRM intake leak, not an ads underperformance issue. Nacer/CRM team to audit the GHL workflow: confirm lead form submissions are triggering opportunity creation and that Andrew's intake step is connected. Success check: every new inbound Meta lead creates a GHL opportunity within 24 hours, confirmed by Sep 18 pipeline review. This is separate from SMS automation (F3) but both must be resolved together to unblock Marwan's case-count metric.

suggestions.text: Watch CPL vs $45 ceiling once Meta restarts — 3-day signal is unreadable at $0 spend; re-check Sep 17.
suggestions.monday_update: The 28-day CPL of $46.95 sits above the July weekly high of $45, but the last 5 days of zero spend make trend analysis impossible. Once Meta is restored (S1), monitor CPL over the first 3 live days against the $45 ceiling. If CPL holds at or below $45 by Sep 17, no further action needed this cycle. If CPL runs above $45 for 3 consecutive days post-restart, flag for a budget or creative review at the next check.
